sa-madinah-replica-on-a-roof-top.summary: Silver-white rooftop tower with open arch and thin platforms in the distant Madinah photo. Fine shaft, compact rounded crown and long summit pole.

th-udon-thani-unknown.name: Unknown, Udon Thani
th-udon-thani-unknown.summary: Silver-white lower body and orange-brown upper structure in the Udon Thani photo, with looped gallery railing. Open fine-rod lattice, small flat summit balcony and looped needle crown.

tj-dushanbe-shopping-mall-tower.name: Shopping Mall Tower, Dushanbe
tj-dushanbe-shopping-mall-tower.summary: Broad heavy dark-grey members, large arch and two thick square decks in Dushanbe. Regular large X bracing and compact rounded cap; an adjacent glazed bridge joins the tower.

tw-taichung-carton-king.name: Carton King, Taichung
tw-taichung-carton-king.summary: Broad flat triangular braces, wide arch and thick deck edges of Carton King’s white tower in Taichung. Long white needle and pierced decoration below the platform.

us-atlanta-georgia-meccano-model.name: Meccano Eiffel Tower, Atlanta, Georgia
us-atlanta-georgia-meccano-model.summary: Dense white lattice, gold deck edges and deep curved arches in the Atlanta-linked image. Tiered summit pavilion, very long flagpole and warm edge light points.

us-austin-texas-dreyfus-eiffel-tower.name: Dreyfus Eiffel Tower, Austin, Texas
us-austin-texas-dreyfus-eiffel-tower.summary: Red-brown dense lattice and low broad arch of Austin’s Dreyfus tower. Very thin decks, long slender shaft and small rounded pavilion crown.

us-boise-idaho-cafe-de-paris.name: Cafe de Paris, Boise, Idaho
us-boise-idaho-cafe-de-paris.summary: Grey fine-grid splayed legs, square base frame and broad shallow platform in the Boise café photograph. A near-vertical grid shaft continues above the platform beyond the image.

us-gettysburg-pennsylvania-devenshire-ap.name: Eiffel Tower, Gettysburg, Pennsylvania
us-gettysburg-pennsylvania-devenshire-ap.summary: Cream-colored sparse large X bracing and tall straight legs of the Gettysburg residential tower. Long narrow shaft, broad open square cage and no needle.

us-kingston-washington-crepes-restaurant.name: Crepes Restaurant, Kingston , Washington
us-kingston-washington-crepes-restaurant.summary: Bronze fine lattice and high arch of the tower outside Kingston’s crêpe shop. Thin decks, long straight shaft and compact tiered square crown.

us-paris-kentucky-tower-on-a-small-squar.name: Tower on. a small square, Paris, Kentucky
us-paris-kentucky-tower-on-a-small-squar.summary: White fine lattice, two light decks and wide arch on the Paris Kentucky square. White stepped summit housing and fine needle.

uz-samarkand-eiffel-tower.name: Eiffel Tower, Samarkand
uz-samarkand-eiffel-tower.summary: Grey-silver fine lattice and broad square-railed decks in the Samarkand pool photograph. Small cage and very long antenna above the shaft; building masks the lower body.

vn-ansapa-village-ansapa-park.name: Ansapa Park, Ansapa Village
vn-ansapa-village-ansapa-park.summary: Dark bronze tower at Ansapa, with a broad high arch, thin decks and a long straight shaft. Distinct large dark dome crown with golden edges.

vn-bac-giang-nha-hang-cua-o.name: Nhà Hàng Cua Đỏ, Bac Giang
vn-bac-giang-nha-hang-cua-o.summary: Deep lattice arches, dense decorative skirt and broad high-railed first deck in Bac Giang. Grey-bronze long shaft; square summit cage with upright fins and fine needle.

za-parys-eiffel-toring-tower.name: Eiffel Toring/Tower, Parys
za-parys-eiffel-toring-tower.summary: Sparse rusty-brown lattice and light decks of the Parys Eiffel Toring event-site tower. Tall straight shaft topped by a broad open square railing and long antenna.

za-parys-old-ferry-house-restaurant.name: Old Ferry House Restaurant, Parys
za-parys-old-ferry-house-restaurant.summary: Very sparse dark frame, low deck and long open shaft at Parys Old Ferry House. Large clock housing and warm light string; needle tip lies beyond the photo.

za-parys-tower-between-the-street-and-sh.name: Tower between the street and shops, Parys
za-parys-tower-between-the-street-and-sh.summary: Very sparse white straight rods and four broadly curved legs of the Parys street tower. Two open-railed decks, small square pavilion and pointed roof.

za-parys-tower-in-arts-quarter.name: Tower in arts quarter, Parys
za-parys-tower-in-arts-quarter.summary: Red-brown main frame, grey crossed rods and long straight shaft in Parys Arts Quarter. Wide open small cage, distinct rounded dome and long needle.

ca-beloeil-cypress-tree.name: Cypress Tree, Beloeil
ca-beloeil-cypress-tree.summary: Dense leafy body, four broad feet and low arch opening of Beloeil’s clipped cypress tower. Stepped flaring lower body and a long thick rounded canopy.

us-gasquet-gasquet-market.name: Gasquet Market, Gasquet
us-gasquet-gasquet-market.summary: Low heavy arched feet, very thick broad square deck and four sloping middle piers of the Gasquet cobble tower. Thick tapering round column and broad flattened mushroom-like cap.

us-kings-island-ohio-eiffel-tower-topiar.name: Eiffel Tower Topiary, Kings Island, Ohio
us-kings-island-ohio-eiffel-tower-topiar.summary: Dense clipped green foliage and four separated lower legs of the Kings Island topiary. Near-vertical green column; summit only partly visible.

ua-dnipro-eiffel-tower-wind-farm-in-the-.name: Eiffel Tower wind farm in the yard of a private house, Dnipro
ua-dnipro-eiffel-tower-wind-farm-in-the-.summary: Narrow four feet and near-vertical fine lattice of the Dnipro garden wind tower. Five white rotor blades, nacelle and long tail vane are actually visible.

ua-kamyanyi-mist-7th-sky-airport-restaur.name: "7th Sky Airport" restaurant, Kamyanyi mist
ua-kamyanyi-mist-7th-sky-airport-restaur.summary: Very low base stages and exceptionally long slender shaft at the Kamyanyi Mist restaurant. Two thin square decks, small pointed square crown and sparse regular lattice.

ua-kyiv-andriivskyi-descent.name: Andriivskyi descent, Kyiv
ua-kyiv-andriivskyi-descent.summary: Gold-brown small tower on Kyiv Baguette’s veranda corner, with two thin decks. Upper shaft dominated by fine near-vertical rods and a small stepped square cap.

ua-lutsk-beside-a-restaurant-next-to-a-c.name: Beside a restaurant, next to a car garage, Lutsk
ua-lutsk-beside-a-restaurant-next-to-a-c.summary: Orange-red tower beside the Lutsk restaurant, with slender lattice shaft and two thin decks. Broad arch, ribbed rounded summit cage and very long needle.

ua-maryanivka-eiffel-tower-in-a-park.name: Eiffel Tower in a park, Maryanivka
ua-maryanivka-eiffel-tower-in-a-park.summary: Straight fine shaft and dark-edged twin decks of the grey Maryanivka park tower. Stepped square cap and especially long needle; trees obscure the feet.

ua-novodnistrovsk-tower-at-a-travel-agen.name: Tower at a travel agency, Novodnistrovsk
ua-novodnistrovsk-tower-at-a-travel-agen.summary: Pale tower at the Novodnistrovsk entrance has broad flat cross members. Two thin decks, high rounded arch, narrow shaft and small open domed cage with needle.

ua-shatsk-yard-of-a-private-house.name: Yard of a private house, Shatsk
ua-shatsk-yard-of-a-private-house.summary: Dark sparse lattice and unusually wide-splayed feet of the Shatsk garden tower. White twin decks and white summit pavilion, with a very long needle above the straight shaft.

ua-shypyntsi-shale-restaurant.name: 'Shale' restaurant, Shypyntsi
ua-shypyntsi-shale-restaurant.summary: Pale beige-grey Shale restaurant tower in Shypyntsi has deep lattice arches and a broad-railed first deck. Blue-violet shaft lights and warm lower fill are visible; open domed crown and long needle.

ua-uzhgorod-a-tower-near-the-greek-catho.name: a tower near the greek catholic cathedral, Uzhgorod
ua-uzhgorod-a-tower-near-the-greek-catho.summary: Small fixed bronze tower on the Uzhhorod lamppost, with mostly solid surfaces and shallow lattice relief. Low semicircular opening, two broad continuous bands, slender shaft and small rounded cap.
